summary: This bill reauthorizes and significantly increases funding for the Federal Work-Study program, modifies the allocation formula to prioritize institutions with higher Pell Grant recipient completion rates and student populations, and expands the types of eligible work-study activities to include more work-based learning and community service, while also establishing a pilot grant program for work-based learning opportunities and requiring surveys to improve student and employer experiences.

scores.thoughts: This bill reauthorizes and significantly increases funding for the Federal Work-Study program, which provides financial aid to students for part-time employment to help finance their education. It also expands the scope of eligible work-study activities to include child development and early learning, and emphasizes work-based learning. This directly translates to more spending on higher education, which is a component of public education.
